name: cardinality-supplying-tier-gates-are-explicit
body: `validate_cardinalities` gates only the two tier-crossing coverage rules whose subject tier is more abstract than their data tier (requirement coverage on Domain in scope, service realisation on Solution in scope); every other scope-aware loop relies on its subject tier already including its data tier in the cumulative window. The one scope-blind loop is the `implemented-by` claim exclusivity (one Component per code node): a shared claim is a whole-model violation and is reported under every scope. Limit: a future rule whose subject tier is more abstract than its data supply must add its own supplying-tier gate. Upgrade by centralising the gate (a rule-to-supplying-tier table) when a third gated rule appears.
